nfiguration")
    return liberty, config, str(technology_id)


def _proof_passed(proof: Any, *, context: str) -> None:
    if not isinstance(proof, dict):
        raise TimingEvidenceError(f"{context} is malformed")
    result = proof.get("proof")
    if not isinstance(result, dict):
        raise TimingEvidenceError(f"{context}.proof is malformed")
    if result.get("performed") is not True or result.get("passed") is not True:
        raise TimingEvidenceError(f"{context} did not pass")
    if result.get("proof_success") is not True or result.get("counterexample_found") is not False:
        raise TimingEvidenceError(
            f"{context} is not a successful positive equivalence proof"
        )


def _collect_analyses(
    area_root: Path,
    area: dict[str, Any],
    formal: dict[str, Any],
) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    area_backends = area.get("backends")
    formal_backends = formal.get("backends")
    if not isinstance(area_backends, dict) or not isinstance(formal_backends, dict):
        raise TimingEvidenceError("ABC backend evidence is malformed")
    if set(area_backends) != set(_BACKENDS) or set(formal_backends) != set(_BACKENDS):
        raise TimingEvidenceError("timing evidence requires the three matched backends")

    analyses: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    unique_digests: set[str] = set()
    total_runs = 0
    for backend_name in _BACKENDS:
        area_backend = area_backends[backend_name]
        formal_backend = formal_backends[backend_name]
        if not isinstance(area_backend, dict) or not isinstance(formal_backend, dict):
            raise TimingEvidenceError(f"backend {backend_name!r} is malformed")
        module = _safe_module(area_backend.get("module"), context=f"{backend_name}.module")
        if formal_backend.get("module") != module:
            raise TimingEvidenceError(f"backend {backend_name!r} module differs across evidence")
        area_runs = area_backend.get("runs")
        formal_runs = formal_backend.get("runs")
        proofs = formal_backend.get("proofs")
        if not all(isinstance(value, dict) for value in (area_runs, formal_runs, proofs)):
            raise TimingEvidenceError(f"backend {backend_name!r} run evidence is malformed")
        assert isinstance(area_runs, dict)
        assert isinstance(formal_runs, dict)
        assert isinstance(proofs, dict)
        if set(area_runs) != set(formal_runs):
            raise TimingEvidenceError(f"backend {backend_name!r} sweep labels differ")
        total_runs += len(area_runs)

        by_representative: dict[str, list[str]] = defaultdict(list)
        for label, area_run in area_runs.items():
            safe_label = _safe_label(label, context=f"{backend_name}.runs")
            formal_run = formal_runs.get(safe_label)
            if not isinstance(area_run, dict) or not isinstance(formal_run, dict):
                raise TimingEvidenceError(f"run {backend_name}/{safe_label} is malformed")
            repeatability = area_run.get("repeatability")
            if (
                not isinstance(repeatability, dict)
                or repeatability.get("performed") is not True
                or repeatability.get("passed") is not True
                or repeatability.get("normalized_metrics_identical") is not True
            ):
                raise TimingEvidenceError(f"run {backend_name}/{safe_label} is not repeatable")
            artifact = area_run.get("artifacts")
            if not isinstance(artifact, dict):
                raise TimingEvidenceError(f"run {backend_name}/{safe_label} has no artifacts")
            mapped = _resolve_hashed_artifact(
                area_root,
                artifact.get("mapped_verilog"),
                context=f"backends.{backend_name}.runs.{safe_label}.mapped_verilog",
            )
            digest = sha256_file(mapped)
            if formal_run.get("mapped_verilog_sha256") != digest:
                raise TimingEvidenceError(
                    f"formal run {backend_name}/{safe_label} binds a different netlist"
                )
            if formal_run.get("equivalence_verified") is not True:
                raise TimingEvidenceError(f"run {backend_name}/{safe_label} is not equivalent")
            representative = _safe_label(
                formal_run.get("proof_representative"),
                context=f"{backend_name}/{safe_label}.proof_representative",
            )
            by_representative[representative].append(safe_label)

        for representative, aliases in sorted(by_representative.items()):
            if representative not in area_runs:
                raise TimingEvidenceError(
                    f"proof representative {backend_name}/{representative} is absent"
                )
            area_run = area_runs[representative]
            formal_run = formal_runs[representative]
            proof = proofs.get(representative)
            _proof_passed(proof, context=f"{backend_name}.proofs.{representative}")
            assert isinstance(area_run, dict)
            assert isinstance(formal_run, dict)
            assert isinstance(proof, dict)
            artifacts = area_run.get("artifacts")
            if not isinstance(artifacts, dict):
                raise TimingEvidenceError(
                    f"representative {backend_name}/{representative} has no artifacts"
                )
            mapped = _resolve_hashed_artifact(
                area_root,
                artifacts.get("mapped_verilog"),
                context=(
                    f"backends.{backend_name}.runs.{representative}.artifacts.mapped_verilog"
                ),
            )
            digest = sha256_file(mapped)
            if proof.get("mapped_verilog_sha256") != digest:
                raise TimingEvidenceError(
                    f"proof {backend_name}/{representative} binds a different netlist"
                )
            covered = proof.get("covered_labels")
            if not isinstance(covered, list) or sorted(covered) != sorted(aliases):
                raise TimingEvidenceError(
                    f"proof {backend_name}/{representative} covers different labels"
                )
            if digest in unique_digests:
                raise TimingEvidenceError(
                    f"distinct timing analyses unexpectedly share mapped digest {digest}"
                )
            unique_digests.add(digest)
            analyses.append(
                {
                    "backend": backend_name,
                    "representative_label": representative,
                    "covered_labels": sorted(aliases),
                    "pareto_point": representative in area_backend.get("pareto_labels", []),
                    "module": module,
                    "mapped_verilog": mapped,
                    "mapped_verilog_sha256": digest,
                    "mapped_cell_count": formal_run.get("mapped_cell_count"),
                    "abc_library_area": area_run.get("library_area"),
                    "abc_delay_picoseconds":
